sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2020
ACT IV OF 2020
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA JOURNALIST WELFARE ENDOWMENT
FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Journalist Welfare Endowment Fund Act, 2014
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
13th January, 2020]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-65 / 2020/790, dated 13.1.2020.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Journalist Welfare
Endowment Fund (Amendment) Bill, 2019 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 24th December, 2019 and assented to by the Governor of
the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 8th January, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Journalist Welfare
Endowment Fund Act. 2014 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No, XII of 2014), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Journalist Welfare Endowment Fund
(Amendment) Act, 2019.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Journalist Welfare
Endowment Fund Act. 2014 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No, XII of 2014), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Amendment
of the Preamble of Act No. XII of 2014.---In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Journalist Welfare Endowment Fund Act, 2014
(Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XII of 2014), hereinafter referred to as the said
Act, for the Preamble, the following shall be substituted, namely:
"WHEREAS
it is expedient to provide for the establishment of Journalists Welfare
Endowment Fund in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, for the welfare of
the deserving journalists working in electronic media, newspapers and news
agencies enlisted in the media list of Government.".

the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Journalist Welfare
Endowment Fund Act. 2014 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No, XII of 2014), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
3. Amendment
of section 2 of the Act No. XII of 2014.---In the said Act, in section 2,-
(a) for
clause (a), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(a)
"Bank" means the Bank of Khyber;";
(b) for
clause (e), the following shall be substituted, namely:
(e)
"deserving journalist" means a bona fide full-time working journalist,
working in electronic media, newspapers and news agencies, who is or has been
member of a press club enlisted with the Directorate General of Information and
Public Relations Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and who is in need of assistance for his
welfare under this Act;";
(c) after
the existing clause (e), the following new clause shall be inserted, namely:
"(e-i)
"electronic media" means different news and current affairs
channels enlisted on central or provincial media lists;";
(d) for
clause (g), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(g)
"family" means family of a deserving journalist including his
or her spouse, as the case may be, dependent son and daughter under twenty five
years of age and dependent parents;";
(e) in
clause (i), the word "and" appearing at the end shall be deleted; and
(f) in
clause (j), the full stop appearing at the end shall be replaced with a
semi-colon and thereafter the following new clauses shall be inserted, namely:
"(k)
"subsistence" means the day to day livelihood requirements of
a deserving journalist which he cannot meet due to unemployment for consecutive
three months; and
(l)
"welfare" means assistance of a deserving journalist and
includes-
(i)
compensation to his family in case of his or her martyrdom in the line of duty:
Provided
that in case of married journalists, his wife and in case of unmarried
journalists, his parents shall be entitled to receive compensation amount;
(ii)
compensation and treatment expenses to a journalist who has got injured in line
of duty or accident;
(iii)
financial assistance for medical treatment in the prescribed manner;
(iv)
financial assistance for expenses incurred upon marriages of a son or daughter
of deserving journalist in the prescribed manner;
Provided
that the marriage grant to a deserving journalist will be made only once;
(v)
monthly stipend for deserving veteran journalists of the age of sixty and
above;
(vii)
subsistence allowance to deserving journalists payable for two months only with
an amount and on the terms and condition as prescribed; and
(viii)
funeral charges in case of death of the journalists or their family
members.".

subsection shall be inserted, namely:
